editorial:
Imagine having your whole life put together, only to have one bad day rip it all apart. You get to follow two best friends who are polar opposites. Andreas is the perfect family man, while Simon is a mess who spends his time drinking and partying. They are both cops, but their worlds collide when a routine call to a drug house goes wrong. Finding a baby abandoned in a closet triggers something inside Andreas, and you can feel his world start to crumble as he decides to take matters into his own hands. It is a heavy story that asks if it is ever okay to break the law to do what you think is right.

The acting is what really sells this movie, making you feel every bit of the stress and sadness. The way the roles flip—with the messy friend becoming the stable one—is a great touch. While it can feel a bit slow in the middle, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you are into moody dramas with a lot of tension, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you want the best picture, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After Andreas kidnaps the baby to save him from his parents, he tries to raise the child in secret. This leads to a huge mess because you cannot just steal a baby without people noticing. Eventually, the truth comes out. Simon has to step up and help his friend deal with the fallout. The movie ends with Andreas facing the consequences of his actions, showing that while his heart was in the right place, he could not escape the law.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty crime dramas and stories about friendship.
